scholarships.name: Voice of Democracy
scholarships.eligibility: High school students in grades 9-12 who submit an audio essay on the annual patriotic theme to their local VFW Post.
scholarships.summary_en: High school students in grades 9 to 12 can record an audio essay on the yearly patriotic theme and give it to a local VFW Post. Check the VFW program page for the deadline and prize.
scholarships.summary_es: Los estudiantes de preparatoria de 9.º a 12.º grado pueden grabar un ensayo en audio sobre el tema patriótico del año y entregarlo en su Puesto local de la VFW. Revisen la página del programa para ver la fecha límite y el premio.

scholarships.name: Alluri Family STEM Scholarship
scholarships.summary_en: Dallas College students studying STEM with a 3.0 GPA or higher can apply. You need an essay and a recommendation, plus a FAFSA by May 1. Deadline is November 1, 2026.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de Dallas College en carreras STEM con promedio de 3.0 o más pueden aplicar. Necesitan ensayo, carta de recomendación y FAFSA antes del 1 de mayo. Fecha límite: 1 de noviembre de 2026.

scholarships.name: Capital One Auto Tech Scholarship
scholarships.summary_en: Dallas College students in auto technology can apply. You need a 2.5 GPA, 6 credit hours, and fewer than 30 hours completed. The $1,000 is for spring. Apply by November 1.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes del Dallas College en tecnología automotriz pueden aplicar. Necesitas promedio de 2.5, 6 horas de clase y menos de 30 horas completadas. La beca de $1,000 es para primavera. Fecha límite: 1 de noviembre.

scholarships.name: Dallas College Faculty Association Endowed Scholarship
scholarships.summary_en: Dallas College students with a 3.0 GPA, 12 completed credit hours, and 6 credit hours in spring can apply. Answer essay questions and get two recommendations by November 1, 2026.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de Dallas College con promedio de 3.0, 12 créditos completados y 6 créditos en primavera pueden postularse. Responde preguntas de ensayo y consigue dos cartas de recomendación antes del 1 de noviembre de 2026.

scholarships.name: Dallas College Retirees Association Endowed Scholarship
scholarships.summary_en: Full-time Dallas College students in Dallas County with a 3.5 GPA and 24 completed credit hours can apply. You need an instructor recommendation and written answers about your goals. Due November 1, 2026.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de tiempo completo con promedio de 3.5 o más y 24 horas de crédito pueden aplicar. Necesitas la recomendación de un profesor y respuestas sobre tus metas. Vence el 1 de noviembre de 2026.

scholarships.name: Dental Hygiene Professional Scholarship
scholarships.summary_en: Dallas College students in their first or second year of the Dental Hygiene program can apply. You need a 3.0 GPA, full-time enrollment, and answers to supplemental questions.
scholarships.summary_es: Pueden aplicar los estudiantes de Dallas College que estén en su primer o segundo año del programa de Higiene Dental. Necesitas un promedio de 3.0, estudiar de tiempo completo y responder las preguntas adicionales.

scholarships.name: Dye Foundation Nursing Endowed Scholarship
scholarships.summary_en: Nursing students at Dallas College with a 2.0 GPA or higher and at least 6 credit hours this semester can apply for this $500 scholarship.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de enfermería en Dallas College con un promedio de 2.0 o más y al menos 6 horas de crédito este semestre pueden solicitar esta beca de 500 dólares.

scholarships.name: Erick Trujillo Study Abroad and Field Study Scholarship
scholarships.summary_en: Dallas College students who study abroad or take a field study trip can apply. Need 2.5 GPA, 12 Dallas College credits, 6 credits this period, financial need, and a FAFSA by May 1.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de Dallas College que estudian en el extranjero o hacen un estudio de campo pueden aplicar. Requieren promedio de 2.5, 12 créditos en Dallas College, necesidad financiera y el FAFSA antes del 1 de mayo.

scholarships.name: Jerry Jones Music Scholarship (full-time students)
scholarships.summary_en: Music students at the El Centro Campus of Dallas College can apply. You need a 2.0 GPA, 12 or more credit hours, and a 2-minute audition video. Deadline is November 1, 2026.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de música en el campus El Centro de Dallas College pueden solicitar. Necesitas un promedio de 2.0, 12 o más horas de crédito y un video de audición de 2 minutos. La fecha límite es el 1 de noviembre de 2026.

scholarships.name: Jerry Jones Music Scholarship (part-time students)
scholarships.summary_en: Music students at Dallas College's El Centro Campus, full-time or part-time with a 2.0 GPA, can apply. Take up to 6 credit hours and send an audition video by November 1, 2026.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de música del Campus El Centro de Dallas College, de tiempo completo o parcial, con promedio de 2.0, pueden aplicar. Tomen hasta 6 horas de crédito y envíen un video de audición antes del 1 de noviembre de 2026.

scholarships.name: Jim White and Vicki Briley-White Scholarship
scholarships.summary_en: Dallas College students in culinary arts, baking and pastry or hospitality management can apply. You need a 2.0 GPA, at least 6 credit hours this term, financial need, an essay and a recommendation.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de Dallas College que estudian artes culinarias, repostería o administración de hospitalidad pueden aplicar. Necesitas promedio de 2.0, al menos 6 horas de crédito este semestre, necesidad financiera, un ensayo y una recomendación.

scholarships.name: John Berry Management Endowed Scholarship
scholarships.summary_en: Management students at Dallas College's El Centro Campus can apply. You need a 2.5 GPA, 6 credit hours each semester, proof of financial need on the FAFSA, an essay, and a recommendation.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes del programa de Administración en el Campus El Centro de Dallas College pueden solicitar esta beca. Necesitas un promedio de 2.5, 6 créditos cada semestre, necesidad económica comprobada con el FAFSA, un ensayo y una carta de recomendación.

scholarships.name: Josephine Jones Memorial Scholarship
scholarships.summary_en: Dallas College students studying Information Technology can apply. You need a 2.0 GPA, at least 6 college credits from Dallas College, and 12 credit hours this term.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de Dallas College que estudian Tecnología de la Información pueden postularse. Necesitas un promedio de 2.0, al menos 6 créditos en Dallas College y estar inscrito en 12 créditos este semestre.

scholarships.name: Kay Clendenen Surgical Technologist Memorial Endowed Scholarship
scholarships.summary_en: Dallas College Surgical Technology students with a 3.0 GPA, U.S. citizenship and financial need can apply. Submit an essay and a completed FAFSA by November 1, 2026.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes del programa de Tecnología Quirúrgica del Dallas College con promedio de 3.0, ciudadanía estadounidense y necesidad económica pueden postularse. Envíen un ensayo y el FAFSA completo antes del 1 de noviembre de 2026.

scholarships.name: Lone Star Corvette Club Automotive Technology Scholarship
scholarships.summary_en: Dallas College Automotive or Auto Body Technology students with a 2.5 GPA, 6+ credits this semester, and 12 Dallas College credits can apply. Submit an essay with the general scholarship application by November 1, 2026.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de Dallas College en Tecnología Automotriz o Tecnología de Carrocería con promedio de 2.5, al menos 6 créditos este semestre y 12 créditos en Dallas College pueden aplicar. Envíen un ensayo con la solicitud general de becas antes del 1 de noviembre de 2026.

scholarships.name: Mountain View Dance Scholarship
scholarships.summary_en: Open to Mountain View Campus students in a dance class with 3+ credit hours. Send a 2-minute audition video. Apply by November 1, 2026. You get $200 each semester.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes del Campus Mountain View que toman clase de danza con 3 o más créditos. Envíe un video de audición de 2 minutos. Fecha límite: 1 de noviembre de 2026. Recibe $200 cada semestre.

scholarships.name: Richard McCrary International Study-Abroad Endowed Scholarship
scholarships.summary_en: Dallas College students with a 2.5 GPA or higher and 12 college credits can apply. You must be accepted into a Dallas College summer study abroad trip. Apply by November 1, 2026.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de Dallas College con promedio de 2.5 o más y 12 créditos universitarios pueden aplicar. Debes haber sido aceptado en un viaje de estudio en el extranjero de verano de Dallas College. Fecha límite: 1 de noviembre de 2026.

scholarships.name: Teruko Sampson Memorial Scholarship - Dance Merit
scholarships.summary_en: Dallas College Brookhaven Campus dance majors with a 3.0 GPA and 5 dance credit hours can apply. Send an essay, a dance video and a CV by November 1, 2026.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de danza del Campus Brookhaven de Dallas College con promedio de 3.0 y al menos 5 créditos en danza pueden aplicar. Pueden enviar un ensayo, un video de danza y un currículum antes del 1 de noviembre de 2026.

scholarships.name: Regeneron Science Talent Search (STS)
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors in the United States developing original scientific research projects.
scholarships.summary_en: High school seniors in the U.S. can enter this national science research competition with an original project. Applications are due November 5, 2026. Finalists compete in March 2027.
scholarships.summary_es: Si estás en último año de preparatoria en Estados Unidos, puedes participar en este concurso nacional de investigación científica con un proyecto original. La fecha límite es el 5 de noviembre de 2026 y los finalistas compiten en marzo de 2027.

scholarships.name: Cooke College Scholarship Program
scholarships.eligibility: High-achieving high school seniors with financial need who plan to attend a top four-year college or university.
scholarships.summary_en: High school seniors with strong grades and financial need can apply for up to $55,000 a year to attend a top four-year college. Apply by November 11, 2026.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de último año de secundaria con buen rendimiento y necesidad económica pueden solicitar hasta $55,000 al año para estudiar en una de las mejores universidades de cuatro años. La fecha límite es el 11 de noviembre de 2026.

scholarships.name: NHS Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: High school senior who is an active member in good standing of a National Honor Society chapter and planning to pursue a degree at an accredited U.S. college, university, military institute, or trade school.
scholarships.summary_en: High school seniors who are active National Honor Society members can apply. You need an NHS student account verified by your chapter adviser. Submit the application by November 20, 2026.
scholarships.summary_es: Pueden aplicar los estudiantes del último año de preparatoria que sean miembros activos de la Sociedad Nacional de Honor. Necesitas una cuenta de estudiante de NHS verificada por tu asesor. Envía la solicitud antes del 20 de noviembre de 2026.

scholarships.name: United States Senate Youth Program
scholarships.eligibility: High school students must be actively serving in high-level elected or appointed leadership positions and be selected by their state.
scholarships.summary_en: High school juniors and seniors who hold elected or appointed student leadership roles can apply through their school or state contact. Each state picks its own delegates and sets its own deadline, so ask your counselor.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de penúltimo y último año de preparatoria con cargos de liderazgo elegidos o designados pueden aplicar con su escuela o el contacto estatal. Cada estado elige a sus delegados y fija su fecha límite, así que pregunte a su consejero.

scholarships.name: Red Wing Shoe Company Skilled Trades Scholarship
scholarships.sponsor: Red Wing Shoe Company in partnership with SkillsUSA
scholarships.eligibility: SkillsUSA members pursuing postsecondary education in eligible skilled trades fields (Construction, Manufacturing, Transportation, Distribution, or Logistics).
scholarships.summary_en: SkillsUSA members who plan to study construction, manufacturing, transportation, distribution or logistics can apply for $2,500. It can be used for trade school, college, apprenticeships or certificates. Apply by December 11, 2026.
scholarships.summary_es: Si eres miembro de SkillsUSA y quieres estudiar construcción, manufactura, transporte, distribución o logística, puedes pedir $2,500. Sirve para escuelas técnicas, colegios, aprendizajes o certificados. La fecha límite es el 11 de diciembre de 2026.

scholarships.name: Chicana Latina Foundation Leadership and Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Latina students who demonstrate commitment to equality and justice for Chicana and Latina women and leadership qualities within the Latinx community.
scholarships.summary_en: Latina undergraduate students who show leadership and commitment to equality for Chicana and Latina women can apply for a $1,500 scholarship. Applications for 2027 open January 1, 2027. Check the website for the deadline.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes latinas de pregrado que demuestren liderazgo y compromiso con la igualdad de las mujeres chicanas y latinas pueden pedir una beca de $1,500. La solicitud para 2027 abre el 1 de enero de 2027. Revisa el sitio web para saber la fecha límite.

scholarships.name: Live Más Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: No GPA or standardized test score requirements; applicants share their passion, community, and impact.
scholarships.summary_en: Taco Bell Foundation offers a $25,000 Live Más Scholarship. No GPA or test scores needed. Share your passion, your community and the impact you want to make. Apply by January 5, 2027.
scholarships.summary_es: La Fundación Taco Bell ofrece una beca Live Más de $25,000. No piden promedio ni exámenes. Cuenta qué te apasiona, sobre tu comunidad y el cambio que quieres lograr. Aplica antes del 5 de enero de 2027.

scholarships.name: APIA Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Undergraduate students with high financial need who are first-generation college students and citizens/nationals/permanent residents of the US or Pacific island nations.
scholarships.summary_en: Undergraduate students with high financial need can apply for APIA Scholarship awards of $2,500 to $20,000. Applications open November 15, 2026 and close January 15, 2027. First-generation students are prioritized.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes universitarios con gran necesidad económica pueden solicitar becas APIA de $2,500 a $20,000. La solicitud abre el 15 de noviembre de 2026 y cierra el 15 de enero de 2027. Se da prioridad a quienes son los primeros en su familia en ir a la universidad.

scholarships.name: Collegiate/Graduate Scholars
scholarships.eligibility: Undergraduates entering sophomore, junior, or senior year and new or continuing graduate students pursuing engineering, engineering technology, or computer science degrees.
scholarships.summary_en: Undergraduates entering sophomore, junior or senior year and graduate students studying engineering, engineering technology or computer science can apply. The application opens December 1, 2026 and closes February 1, 2027.
scholarships.summary_es: Es para estudiantes que van a segundo, tercer o cuarto año de licenciatura, o que hacen posgrado, en ingeniería, tecnología de ingeniería o ciencias de la computación. La solicitud abre el 1 de diciembre de 2026 y cierra el 1 de febrero de 2027.

scholarships.name: Emerging First Year Scholars
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors and students entering their first year of undergraduate study pursuing engineering, engineering technology, or computer science degrees.
scholarships.summary_en: High school seniors and students starting their first year of college in engineering, engineering technology or computer science can apply. The application opens February 8, 2027 and closes March 31, 2027.
scholarships.summary_es: Pueden aplicar estudiantes de último año de preparatoria o que van a empezar su primer año de universidad en ingeniería, tecnología de ingeniería o ciencias de la computación. La solicitud abre el 8 de febrero de 2027 y cierra el 31 de marzo de 2027.

scholarships.name: Cameron Impact Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: High school Class of 2028 with a minimum 3.7 unweighted GPA, U.S. citizenship, planned full-time enrollment at an accredited four-year U.S. college, and demonstrated leadership and community service.
scholarships.summary_en: High school seniors graduating in 2028 with a 3.7 unweighted GPA who are U.S. citizens can apply. Applications open February 1, 2027 and close May 1, 2027 or sooner. You need two recommendations and a transcript.
scholarships.summary_es: Pueden aplicar estudiantes que se gradúen de la preparatoria en 2028, con promedio de 3.7 sin ponderar y ciudadanía estadounidense. Se abre el 1 de febrero de 2027 y cierra el 1 de mayo de 2027 o antes. Necesita dos cartas de recomendación y su transcripción.

scholarships.name: TMCF Gap Completion Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Students at TMCF member schools and other eligible accredited institutions with urgent financial needs.
scholarships.summary_en: TMCF offers scholarships for students at member schools. Create a profile in the TMCF portal and complete the general application. The system will then show which scholarships you match. Details for this one need checking.
scholarships.summary_es: TMCF ofrece becas para estudiantes de las escuelas miembro. Crea tu perfil en el portal de TMCF y completa la solicitud general. El sistema te mostrará las becas que te corresponden. Falta confirmar los detalles de esta beca.

scholarships.name: TMCF Access Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Students at TMCF member schools and other eligible accredited institutions.
scholarships.summary_en: TMCF offers scholarships for students at its member schools. Create a profile in the TMCF Scholarship Portal, complete the general application and apply to the scholarships you match with. Check the portal for deadlines and amounts.
scholarships.summary_es: TMCF ofrece becas para estudiantes de sus escuelas miembro. Crea un perfil en el portal de becas de TMCF, completa la solicitud general y aplica a las becas que te correspondan. Revisa el portal para ver fechas límite y montos.

scholarships.name: TMCF Programmatic Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Students at TMCF member schools and other eligible accredited institutions.
scholarships.summary_en: TMCF offers scholarships to students at its member schools and other eligible colleges. Create a profile in the TMCF Scholarship Portal, complete the general application, then apply to the scholarships you are matched with.
scholarships.summary_es: TMCF ofrece becas a estudiantes de sus universidades miembro y de otras instituciones elegibles. Crea un perfil en el portal de becas de TMCF, completa la solicitud general y luego aplica a las becas que te correspondan.

scholarships.name: Honeywell Technologies Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Registered paid NSBE member, sophomore to senior, minimum 3.0 GPA, pursuing a listed engineering, computer science, or IT major, U.S. citizen or permanent resident.
scholarships.summary_en: NSBE members who are sophomores, juniors or seniors in a listed engineering, computer science or IT major can apply for $5,000. You need a 3.0 GPA and U.S. citizenship or permanent residency. Check NSBE for the deadline.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes miembros de NSBE que cursen el segundo, tercer o cuarto año en ingeniería, computación o tecnología pueden pedir $5,000. Necesitas un promedio de 3.0 y ser ciudadano o residente permanente. Revisa el sitio de NSBE para ver la fecha límite.

scholarships.name: NSBE Jr. Golden Torch Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors who are NSBE members with a minimum 3.5 GPA, pursuing any NSBE-related major.
scholarships.summary_en: High school seniors who are paid NSBE members with a 3.5 GPA or higher can apply for this $1000 award. Check the NSBE site for the deadline and how to apply.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes del último año de preparatoria que sean miembros de NSBE con pago al día y tengan promedio de 3.5 o más pueden solicitar este premio de $1000. Revisa el sitio de NSBE para saber la fecha límite y cómo aplicar.

scholarships.name: NSBE Academic Improvement Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: NSBE members from freshman to senior year or high school seniors with a minimum 2.0 GPA in any NSBE major.
scholarships.summary_en: NSBE members who are high school seniors or college students (freshman to senior) with at least a 2.0 GPA can apply for $1,000. You must be a paid NSBE member. Check NSBE for the deadline.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de último año de preparatoria o de la universidad que sean miembros de NSBE y tengan al menos 2.0 de promedio pueden solicitar $1,000. Debe pagar la membresía de NSBE. Revise el plazo en el sitio de NSBE.

scholarships.name: Cummins Inc. Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Sophomore or junior NSBE members at Region 2 or 4 schools (including Howard and NC A&T) with a minimum 3.0 GPA in a listed engineering or computer science major.
scholarships.summary_en: NSBE members who are sophomores or juniors in certain engineering or computer science majors, with a 3.0 GPA, at Region 2 or 4 schools, Howard or NC A&T, can apply for $10,000. Check NSBE for the deadline.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de segundo o tercer año que sean miembros de NSBE, con promedio de 3.0 y una carrera de ingeniería o computación en escuelas de las Regiones 2 o 4, Howard o NC A&T, pueden pedir $10,000. Revisa la fecha límite en NSBE.

scholarships.name: NSBE Study Abroad Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: NSBE members who are juniors, seniors, or graduate students with a minimum 3.0 GPA, studying abroad in a STEM program.
scholarships.summary_en: Paid NSBE members who are juniors, seniors or graduate students with a 3.0 GPA can apply for $1000 to study abroad in a STEM program. Check NSBE for the deadline and how to apply.
scholarships.summary_es: Si eres miembro activo de NSBE, estás en tercer o cuarto año o en posgrado y tienes un promedio de 3.0, puedes pedir $1000 para estudiar en el extranjero en un programa STEM. Consulta con NSBE la fecha límite y cómo aplicar.

scholarships.name: NSBE Jr. Graduating Senior Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: NSBE member high school seniors with a minimum 3.0 GPA, pursuing any NSBE-related major.
scholarships.summary_en: High school seniors who are paid NSBE members with at least a 3.0 GPA can apply for this $500 scholarship. Check the NSBE site for the deadline and how to apply.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de último año de preparatoria que sean miembros pagados de NSBE y tengan promedio de 3.0 o más pueden solicitar esta beca de $500. Revisa el sitio de NSBE para ver la fecha límite y cómo aplicar.

scholarships.name: Cargill Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: NSBE members in Region 4 or 5 with a minimum 2.7 GPA, pursuing a listed engineering or computer science major, U.S. citizen or permanent resident.
scholarships.summary_en: NSBE members in Region 4 or 5 studying engineering or computer science can apply for $5,000. You need a 2.7 GPA and must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident. Check the NSBE site for the deadline.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes miembros de NSBE en la Región 4 o 5 que estudian ingeniería o computación pueden pedir $5,000. Necesitas un promedio de 2.7 y ser ciudadano o residente permanente de EE. UU. Revisa el sitio de NSBE para ver la fecha límite.

scholarships.name: NSBE Fulfilling the Legacy Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: NSBE members from high school seniors through graduate students with a minimum 3.0 GPA in any NSBE major.
scholarships.summary_en: NSBE members from high school seniors to graduate students with a 3.0 GPA can apply for this $500 award. You must be a paid NSBE member. Check NSBE for the deadline before applying.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes miembros de NSBE, desde el último año de preparatoria hasta posgrado, con promedio de 3.0, pueden pedir este premio de $500. Debes ser miembro con la cuota pagada. Revisa la fecha límite en NSBE antes de aplicar.

scholarships.name: Intel Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Freshman to junior NSBE members with a minimum 3.0 GPA in a listed STEM major.
scholarships.summary_en: NSBE members in their first, second or third year of college, studying engineering or another listed STEM major with a 3.0 GPA or higher, can apply for $5,000. Check the NSBE site for the deadline.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes miembros de NSBE en su primer, segundo o tercer año de universidad, en ingeniería u otra carrera STEM de la lista y con promedio de 3.0 o más, pueden pedir $5,000. Revisa el sitio de NSBE para ver la fecha límite.

scholarships.name: Deloitte Foundation Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Freshman to junior NSBE members with a minimum 3.0 GPA in a listed engineering, computer, or technology major, U.S. citizen or permanent resident; renewable up to 4 semesters.
scholarships.summary_en: NSBE members who are freshmen, sophomores or juniors studying engineering, computer science or technology with a 3.0 GPA can apply. You must be a U.S. citizen or permanent resident. Check NSBE for the deadline.
scholarships.summary_es: Pueden aplicar miembros de NSBE que cursen el primer, segundo o tercer año de ingeniería, computación o tecnología con promedio de 3.0. Debes ser ciudadano o residente permanente de EE. UU. Revisa el plazo en NSBE.

scholarships.name: Leroy Callendar NSBE Jr. Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: NSBE member high school seniors with a minimum 3.0 GPA, pursuing any NSBE-related major.
scholarships.summary_en: High school seniors who are paid NSBE members with a 3.0 GPA or higher can apply for this $500 scholarship. Any NSBE major counts. Check the NSBE site for the deadline and how to apply.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de último año de preparatoria que sean miembros pagados de NSBE y tengan promedio de 3.0 o más pueden pedir esta beca de $500. Sirve cualquier carrera de NSBE. Revisa el sitio de NSBE para ver la fecha límite y cómo aplicar.

scholarships.name: Chevron Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: NSBE members in Region 3, 5, or 6 who are high school seniors or freshman to junior undergraduates with a minimum 3.0 GPA in a listed engineering or computer major.
scholarships.summary_en: NSBE members in Regions 3, 5 or 6 can apply. You must be a high school senior or a freshman, sophomore or junior studying engineering or computer science, with a 3.0 GPA. Check the NSBE site for the deadline.
scholarships.summary_es: Es para miembros de NSBE en las regiones 3, 5 o 6. Debes ser estudiante de último año de secundaria, o de primero a tercer año de universidad, en ingeniería o computación, con promedio de 3.0. Revisa el sitio de NSBE para la fecha límite.
scholarships.residency: Regions 3, 5 and 6 (U.S. citizen or permanent resident)

scholarships.name: Grad Student Conference Travel Grant
scholarships.eligibility: Graduate student NSBE members with a minimum 2.5 GPA planning to attend the NSBE Annual Convention GSC mini conference.
scholarships.summary_en: Graduate students who are paid NSBE members with at least a 2.5 GPA can apply for $500 to help them attend the NSBE Annual Convention graduate student mini conference. Check NSBE for dates.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de posgrado que son miembros de NSBE con membresía pagada y un promedio mínimo de 2.5 pueden pedir $500 para asistir a la miniconferencia de posgrado de la Convención Anual de NSBE. Revisen las fechas con NSBE.

scholarships.name: Graduate Student Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Graduate student NSBE members with a minimum 2.5 GPA in any NSBE major.
scholarships.summary_en: Graduate students who are paid NSBE members with at least a 2.5 GPA can apply for $1000. Check the NSBE site for the deadline and how to apply.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de posgrado que sean miembros activos de NSBE y tengan un promedio de al menos 2.5 pueden solicitar $1000. Revisa el sitio de NSBE para ver la fecha límite y cómo aplicar.

scholarships.name: Honeywell Aerospace Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Freshman to senior and graduate NSBE members with a minimum 3.0 GPA in a listed aerospace, engineering, or computer major, U.S. citizen or permanent resident.
scholarships.summary_en: NSBE members who are undergraduate or graduate students in aerospace, engineering or computer fields can apply. You need a 3.0 GPA and U.S. citizenship or permanent residency. The award is $5,000. Check NSBE for the deadline.

scholarships.summary_es: Esta beca vocacional del Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo puede ayudar a estudiantes que van a estudiar un oficio o carrera técnica. No pudimos confirmar la fecha límite ni los requisitos, así que revisa el sitio del patrocinador antes de aplicar.

scholarships.name: Hildebrand Rural Scholars Program
scholarships.eligibility: 4-H and FFA members from rural communities
scholarships.summary_en: This scholarship from the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo is listed for 4-H and FFA members from rural communities. The deadline is not confirmed, so check the official site before you apply.
scholarships.summary_es: Esta beca del Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo es para miembros de 4-H y FFA de comunidades rurales. La fecha límite no está confirmada, así que revisa el sitio oficial antes de aplicar.

scholarships.name: Hildebrand Rural Scholars Vocational Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: 4-H and FFA members from rural communities
scholarships.summary_en: This vocational scholarship from the Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo is listed for 4-H and FFA members from rural communities. We could not confirm the deadline or details, so check the sponsor's site before you apply.
scholarships.summary_es: Esta beca vocacional del Houston Livestock Show and Rodeo es para miembros de 4-H y FFA de comunidades rurales. No pudimos confirmar la fecha límite ni los detalles, así que revisa el sitio del patrocinador antes de aplicar.

scholarships.name: TILF Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: UIL (University Interscholastic League) competitors eligible to apply.
scholarships.summary_en: TILF offers scholarships to Texas UIL competitors heading to college. The 2026 application closed on May 22, 2026. Check the TILF website for news about when the next round opens.
scholarships.summary_es: TILF ofrece becas a estudiantes de Texas que participan en UIL y van a la universidad. La solicitud de 2026 cerró el 22 de mayo de 2026. Visite el sitio de TILF para saber cuándo abre la próxima convocatoria.

scholarships.name: Dell Scholars Program
scholarships.eligibility: High school senior graduating from a Texas high school, Pell Grant eligible, minimum 2.4 GPA, participant in approved college readiness program grades 11-12, planning to enroll in accredited four-year public Texas university.
scholarships.summary_en: Texas high school seniors who qualify for a Pell Grant, have a 2.4 GPA and are in an approved college readiness program can apply. Plan to attend a public four-year Texas college. Check the site for dates.
scholarships.summary_es: Pueden aplicar los estudiantes de último año de una escuela secundaria de Texas que califiquen para la beca Pell, tengan promedio de 2.4 y estén en un programa de preparación universitaria aprobado. Deben planear asistir a una universidad pública de Texas. Revisa el sitio para ver las fechas.

scholarships.name: Coca-Cola Scholars Program Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors graduating in 2026-2027 with minimum 3.0 GPA who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents planning to attend accredited U.S. post-secondary institutions.
scholarships.summary_en: High school seniors graduating in 2027 with a 3.0 GPA who are U.S. citizens or eligible noncitizens can apply. The 2027 application is closed. It usually opens each August and closes September 30.
scholarships.summary_es: Pueden aplicar estudiantes de último año que se gradúen en 2027, con promedio de 3.0 y ciudadanía o residencia elegible en EE. UU. La solicitud de 2027 ya cerró. Normalmente abre en agosto y cierra el 30 de septiembre.

scholarships.name: Coca-Cola Community College Academic Team
scholarships.sponsor: Coca-Cola Scholars Foundation / Phi Theta Kappa
scholarships.eligibility: Phi Theta Kappa members enrolled in community colleges (50 Gold Scholars at $1,500, 50 Silver at $1,250, 50 Bronze at $1,000).
scholarships.summary_en: Community college students with a 3.5 GPA and at least 36 credits can be nominated by their college for this academic award. You must be nominated, so ask your college's Phi Theta Kappa advisor about it.
scholarships.summary_es: Es para estudiantes de community college con promedio de 3.5 y al menos 36 créditos. Tu universidad debe nominarte, así que pregunta al asesor de Phi Theta Kappa de tu colegio cómo hacerlo.

scholarships.name: Coca-Cola Leaders of Promise
scholarships.sponsor: Coca-Cola Scholars Foundation / Phi Theta Kappa
scholarships.eligibility: Phi Theta Kappa members enrolled in community colleges.
scholarships.summary_en: Phi Theta Kappa members in an associate degree program can apply for up to $1,000. You need a 3.5 GPA and 12 to 36 completed credits by January 31. Check the PTK site for the deadline.
scholarships.summary_es: Si eres miembro de Phi Theta Kappa y estudias una carrera técnica de dos años, puedes pedir hasta $1,000. Necesitas un promedio de 3.5 y entre 12 y 36 créditos para el 31 de enero. Revisa el sitio de PTK para ver la fecha límite.

scholarships.name: Horatio Alger Association Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Young people overcoming significant challenges and committed to pursuing higher education.
scholarships.summary_en: The Horatio Alger Association helps students who have overcome big challenges and want to go to college. Check the official site for award amounts, deadlines and how to apply before you start.
scholarships.summary_es: La Asociación Horatio Alger apoya a jóvenes que han superado grandes dificultades y quieren estudiar en la universidad. Revisa el sitio oficial para conocer los montos, las fechas límite y cómo aplicar antes de empezar.

scholarships.name: Davidson Fellows Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Gifted, high-achieving U.S. citizens or permanent residents, 18 or younger at the deadline, who have completed a significant piece of work in a submission category.
scholarships.summary_en: Gifted students 18 or younger who are U.S. citizens or permanent residents can apply with a major project. Awards are $25,000 to $100,000. The 2027 application opens this fall, so check back soon.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes con talento de 18 años o menos, ciudadanos o residentes permanentes de EE. UU., pueden postularse con un proyecto importante. Los premios van de $25,000 a $100,000. La solicitud de 2027 abre este otoño, así que vuelva pronto.

scholarships.name: The Hagan Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Parents' Adjusted Household Income must not exceed $125,000.
scholarships.summary_en: Students from families earning $125,000 or less a year can apply for this nationwide scholarship. It gives $1,000 to start, then up to $7,500 each semester for up to 8 semesters. Check the website for dates.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de familias con ingresos de $125,000 al año o menos pueden solicitar esta beca nacional. Da $1,000 para comenzar y hasta $7,500 por semestre durante un máximo de 8 semestres. Revisa el sitio web para ver las fechas.

scholarships.name: The Hagan Graduate Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Must be a Hagan Scholar who has graduated from college while enrolled in the Hagan Scholarship Program.
scholarships.summary_en: This award is only for Hagan Scholars who graduated college while in the Hagan program. It gives up to $7,500 a semester for up to four semesters of graduate school. The page lists no deadline.
scholarships.summary_es: Este apoyo es solo para becarios Hagan que se graduaron de la universidad dentro del programa Hagan. Da hasta $7,500 por semestre durante un máximo de cuatro semestres de posgrado. La página no indica fecha límite.
scholarships.ai_members_only: Hagan Scholarship Program (current or past Hagan Scholars)

scholarships.name: BigFuture Scholarship Sweepstakes
scholarships.eligibility: Open to high school sophomores and juniors with no essay, minimum GPA, or test score requirements.
scholarships.summary_en: College Board's BigFuture offers chances to win a $40,000 or $500 scholarship. Sophomores and juniors can enter by completing steps like building a college list. No essay or GPA needed. Check the official rules first.
scholarships.summary_es: BigFuture de College Board ofrece la oportunidad de ganar una beca de $40,000 o de $500. Los estudiantes de segundo y tercer año pueden participar completando pasos como armar su lista de universidades. No piden ensayo ni promedio mínimo. Revisen primero las reglas oficiales.

scholarships.name: Amazon Future Engineer Scholarship and Internship
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors or college students enrolled in computer science courses with minimum 2.3 GPA, demonstrated financial need, authorized to work in the U.S., and planning to pursue a bachelor's degree in computer science or related field.
scholarships.summary_en: High school seniors who have taken a computer science course, have financial need and a 2.3 GPA, and plan to study computer science can apply for up to $40,000 and a paid Amazon internship. Check the site for dates.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de último año de secundaria que hayan tomado un curso de computación, tengan necesidad económica y un promedio de 2.3, y planeen estudiar computación, pueden pedir hasta $40,000 y una pasantía pagada en Amazon. Revisa el sitio para ver las fechas.

scholarships.name: Samsung American Legion Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: High school juniors and seniors attending Boys State or Girls State who are direct descendants of wartime veterans.
scholarships.summary_en: High school juniors and seniors who attend Boys State or Girls State and are direct descendants of wartime veterans can apply. Check the American Legion program page for the amount, deadline and steps.
scholarships.summary_es: Pueden aplicar estudiantes de los últimos años de preparatoria que asistan a Boys State o Girls State y sean descendientes directos de veteranos de guerra. Revisa la página del programa de The American Legion para ver el monto, la fecha límite y los pasos.

scholarships.name: Legacy Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Children of post-9/11 fallen servicemembers or post-9/11 veterans with 50% or higher VA disability rating.
scholarships.summary_en: The American Legion's Legacy Scholarship helps children of post-9/11 fallen servicemembers or post-9/11 veterans with a 50% or higher VA disability rating pay for college. Check the Legion's website for the deadline and how to apply.
scholarships.summary_es: La beca Legacy de The American Legion ayuda a pagar la universidad a hijos de militares caídos después del 11 de septiembre, o de veteranos con una discapacidad del 50% o más reconocida por el VA. Revise el sitio de la Legión para ver la fecha límite y cómo aplicar.

scholarships.name: Baseball Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: American Legion baseball players based on performance and academic achievement.
scholarships.summary_en: American Legion baseball players can apply for a scholarship worth $500 to $5,000. Awards are based on playing performance and school achievement. Check the Legion website for the deadline and how to apply.
scholarships.summary_es: Los jugadores de béisbol de la Legión Americana pueden pedir una beca de $500 a $5,000. Se otorga por su desempeño en el juego y sus logros escolares. Revise el sitio de la Legión para saber la fecha límite y cómo aplicar.

scholarships.name: Oratorical Contest Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Finalists in The American Legion Oratorical Contest.
scholarships.summary_en: High school students who become finalists in The American Legion Oratorical Contest can win a scholarship of $20,000 to $25,000. Students first compete in the contest, so check the Legion's contest page for dates.
scholarships.summary_es: Los estudiantes que lleguen a la final del Concurso de Oratoria de The American Legion pueden ganar una beca de $20,000 a $25,000. Primero hay que participar en el concurso, así que revisa las fechas en la página de la Legión.

scholarships.name: Eagle Scout of the Year Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Eagle Scouts nominated by state-level committees.
scholarships.summary_en: The American Legion gives a $10,000 scholarship to its Eagle Scout of the Year. Scouts cannot apply directly. A state-level committee must nominate you, so ask your state American Legion office about nominations.
scholarships.summary_es: La Legión Americana otorga una beca de $10,000 al Eagle Scout del Año. No se puede aplicar directamente. Un comité estatal debe nominarte, así que pregunta en la oficina estatal de la Legión Americana cómo funcionan las nominaciones.

scholarships.name: Junior Shooting Sports Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Winners of The American Legion Junior Shooting Sports Championship in Precision and Sporter categories.
scholarships.summary_en: Winners of The American Legion Junior Shooting Sports Championship in the Precision and Sporter categories each get $5,000. Second place finishers get $1,000. You must compete in and win the championship, so check the Legion site for details.
scholarships.summary_es: Quienes ganan el Campeonato Juvenil de Tiro Deportivo de The American Legion en las categorías Precision y Sporter reciben $5,000. El segundo lugar recibe $1,000. Hay que competir y ganar, así que revisa el sitio de la Legión para más detalles.

scholarships.name: ANAVICUS Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Students at specific colleges, ROTC participants, and descendants of ANAVICUS members.
scholarships.summary_en: ANAVICUS offers nine $1,500 scholarships for students at certain colleges, ROTC participants and descendants of ANAVICUS members. Check the American Legion ANAVICUS page for the deadline and how to apply.
scholarships.summary_es: ANAVICUS ofrece nueve becas de $1,500 para estudiantes de ciertas universidades, participantes de ROTC y descendientes de miembros de ANAVICUS. Revise la página de ANAVICUS en American Legion para ver la fecha límite y cómo aplicar.

scholarships.name: DAR National Scholarships
scholarships.sponsor: National Society Daughters of the American Revolution (DAR)
scholarships.eligibility: United States citizen planning to attend an accredited college or university in the United States.
scholarships.summary_en: U.S. citizens attending or planning to attend an accredited U.S. college can apply for DAR scholarships in fields like history, nursing, science and education. The online portal reopens November 1, 2026.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes ciudadanos de EE. UU. que van a una universidad acreditada del país pueden pedir becas de DAR en áreas como historia, enfermería, ciencias y educación. El portal en línea abre el 1 de noviembre de 2026.

scholarships.name: Optimist International Essay Contest
scholarships.eligibility: Contestants must be under 19 on October 1 of the contest year and not have completed high school or its equivalent.
scholarships.summary_en: Students under 19 who have not finished high school can write an essay on this year's topic. Enter through a local Optimist Club, since deadlines vary. District winners compete for $2,500.
scholarships.summary_es: Los estudiantes menores de 19 años que aún no terminan la preparatoria pueden escribir un ensayo sobre el tema de este año. Se participa por medio de un Club Optimista local, que fija su propia fecha límite. Los ganadores de distrito compiten por $2,500.

scholarships.name: Ayn Rand Institute Anthem Essay Contest
scholarships.eligibility: Middle and high school students worldwide, ages 13 and older, enrolled in school during contest period.
scholarships.summary_en: Students ages 13 and older in middle school or high school can write an essay about Ayn Rand's novel Anthem. You must be enrolled in school. Create an account and submit before the deadline. Check the site for dates.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de secundaria y preparatoria de 13 años en adelante pueden escribir un ensayo sobre la novela Anthem de Ayn Rand. Deben estar inscritos en la escuela. Crea una cuenta y envíalo antes de la fecha límite. Revisa el sitio para ver las fechas.

scholarships.name: Ayn Rand Institute Fountainhead Essay Contest
scholarships.eligibility: Middle and high school students worldwide, ages 13 and older, enrolled in school during contest period.
scholarships.summary_en: Middle and high school students ages 13 and older can enter this essay contest about Ayn Rand's novel The Fountainhead. Prizes go up to $25,000. Check the contest page for the deadline before you start.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de secundaria y preparatoria de 13 años o más pueden participar en este concurso de ensayos sobre la novela The Fountainhead de Ayn Rand. Los premios llegan hasta $25,000. Revisa la página del concurso para ver la fecha límite.

scholarships.name: Ayn Rand Institute Atlas Shrugged Essay Contest
scholarships.eligibility: High school, college, and graduate students worldwide, enrolled in school during contest period.
scholarships.summary_en: High school, college and graduate students anywhere can write an essay about Ayn Rand's novel Atlas Shrugged for prizes up to $25,000. You must be enrolled in school and create an account to enter.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de preparatoria, universidad y posgrado de cualquier país pueden escribir un ensayo sobre la novela Atlas Shrugged de Ayn Rand y ganar premios de hasta $25,000. Deben estar inscritos en una escuela y crear una cuenta para participar.

scholarships.name: ACE Austin Alumni Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Former ACE Austin students enrolled at a four-year institution or community college in ACE-related fields, maintaining 3.0+ GPA, and at least third-year standing.
scholarships.summary_en: This scholarship is for former ACE Austin students in ACE-related fields with a 3.0 GPA and third-year standing or higher. The link only leads to a general ACE alumni page, so check details with ACE first.
scholarships.summary_es: Esta beca es para exalumnos de ACE Austin que estudian carreras relacionadas con ACE, con promedio de 3.0 y al menos tercer año. El enlace solo lleva a una página general de ACE, así que confirma los detalles con ACE.

scholarships.name: Women in Architecture (WiA) Minority Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Minority female or minority non-binary undergraduate or graduate architecture students at University of Texas School of Architecture.
scholarships.summary_en: Minority female and minority non-binary architecture students at the University of Texas School of Architecture can apply for $2,500 for the school year. The deadline is not posted, so contact the organizers with questions.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de arquitectura de la Universidad de Texas en Austin que sean mujeres o personas no binarias de minorías pueden pedir $2,500 para el año escolar. No hay fecha límite publicada, así que escriban a los organizadores para preguntar.
scholarships.ai_school: University of Texas School of Architecture

scholarships.name: Construction Career Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: High school seniors interested in pursuing a career in construction.
scholarships.summary_en: High school seniors interested in a construction career may be able to apply for this Austin NAWIC scholarship. We could not confirm the details yet, so check the sponsor's website for the deadline and steps.
scholarships.summary_es: Los estudiantes de último año de preparatoria interesados en una carrera en construcción podrían aplicar a esta beca de Austin NAWIC. Aún no pudimos confirmar los detalles, así que revisa el sitio de la organización para ver la fecha límite y los pasos.

scholarships.name: Albert E. Phillips Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Relatives or employees of COAA Member organizations, or full-time students at COAA Member institutions pursuing careers in design and construction.
scholarships.summary_en: COAA offers up to two $3,000 scholarships each year for college students going into design and construction. You must be a COAA member's relative or employee, or a full-time student at a member school. The deadline is not posted yet.
scholarships.summary_es: COAA ofrece hasta dos becas de $3,000 al año para estudiantes universitarios que quieren trabajar en diseño y construcción. Debe ser pariente o empleado de un miembro de COAA, o estudiar tiempo completo en una institución miembro. Aún no se publica la fecha límite.
scholarships.ai_members_only: Construction Owners Association of America (COAA) member organizations (relative or employee, or full-time student at a member institution)

scholarships.name: SkillsUSA Hope Fund
scholarships.eligibility: Current, active SkillsUSA student members experiencing financial or personal crisis, or SkillsUSA chapters affected by natural disasters (applied for by state director or advisor).
scholarships.summary_en: Current, active SkillsUSA student members facing a financial or personal crisis can get help of $500 to $2,500. Ask your SkillsUSA advisor, officer coach or state director to apply for you.
scholarships.summary_es: Los estudiantes activos de SkillsUSA que enfrentan una crisis económica o personal pueden recibir entre $500 y $2,500. Pídele a tu asesor, al coach de oficiales o al director estatal de SkillsUSA que haga la solicitud por ti.

scholarships.name: SAE Grants
scholarships.eligibility: FFA members with demonstrated financial need.
scholarships.summary_en: Current FFA members in grades 7 to 12 with financial need can apply for a $1,000 grant to start or grow an agricultural project. Applications close November 15. An advisor statement is needed.
scholarships.summary_es: Los miembros activos de FFA de 7.º a 12.º grado con necesidad económica pueden pedir una beca de $1,000 para iniciar o ampliar su proyecto agrícola. La solicitud cierra el 15 de noviembre y se necesita una carta del asesor.

scholarships.name: Pat Tillman Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Open to U.S. military service members, veterans, and spouses enrolled full-time at an accredited U.S. college or university in a bachelor's, master's, or professional program.
scholarships.summary_en: Military service members, veterans and spouses enrolled full-time in a college degree program can apply. Applications open December 1. You need essays, a FAFSA, service documents and one character recommendation.
scholarships.summary_es: Pueden aplicar militares en servicio, veteranos y cónyuges que estudien tiempo completo en la universidad. La solicitud abre el 1 de diciembre. Necesitas ensayos, la FAFSA, documentos de servicio y una recomendación de carácter.

scholarships.name: AMVETS + WD40 Company Veteran Scholarship Program
scholarships.eligibility: Veterans and active duty in the United States military, National Guard or Reserves.
scholarships.summary_en: Veterans and active duty, Guard or Reserve members can apply for two $12,000 scholarships to study skilled construction trades. Check the AMVETS site for the deadline and how to apply.
scholarships.summary_es: Veteranos y miembros activos de las fuerzas armadas, la Guardia o la Reserva pueden solicitar dos becas de $12,000 para estudiar oficios de la construcción. Revisa el sitio de AMVETS para ver la fecha límite y cómo aplicar.

scholarships.name: AMVETS Veteran Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Veterans and active duty in the United States military, National Guard or Reserves.
scholarships.summary_en: AMVETS gives $4,000 scholarships each year to veterans and to active duty, Guard and Reserve members. The page lists no deadline, so check the AMVETS website for dates and how to apply.
scholarships.summary_es: AMVETS ofrece becas de $4,000 cada año a veteranos y a miembros en servicio activo, la Guardia o la Reserva. La página no indica fecha límite, así que revise el sitio de AMVETS para saber cómo aplicar.

scholarships.name: AMVETS Spouse/Widow Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Spouses or widows of veterans and active duty in the United States military, National Guard or Reserves.
scholarships.summary_en: AMVETS offers a $4,000 scholarship for spouses and widows of veterans and of active duty, Guard or Reserve members. Check the AMVETS website for the deadline and how to apply.
scholarships.summary_es: AMVETS ofrece una beca de $4,000 para cónyuges y viudas de veteranos y de miembros en servicio activo, la Guardia o la Reserva. Revise el sitio de AMVETS para ver la fecha límite y cómo aplicar.

scholarships.name: AMVETS Child/Grandchild Scholarship
scholarships.eligibility: Child or grandchild of veterans and active duty in the United States military, National Guard or Reserves.
scholarships.summary_en: AMVETS offers a $4,000 scholarship to children and grandchildren of veterans and of active duty, Guard or Reserve members. The deadline is not listed, so check the AMVETS website before you apply.
scholarships.summary_es: AMVETS ofrece una beca de $4,000 para hijos y nietos de veteranos y de miembros del servicio activo, la Guardia o la Reserva. No aparece la fecha límite, así que revise el sitio de AMVETS antes de aplicar.

scholarships.name: Marine Corps Scholarship Foundation Need-Based Scholarships
scholarships.eligibility: Children of Marines and military families seeking post-secondary education
scholarships.summary_en: The Marine Corps Scholarship Foundation gives need-based scholarships to children of military families for college or career training. Check the foundation's application page for the deadline, amount and rules before you apply.
scholarships.summary_es: La Fundación de Becas del Cuerpo de Marines ofrece becas según la necesidad económica a hijos de familias militares para la universidad o estudios técnicos. Revisa su página de solicitud para ver la fecha límite, el monto y los requisitos antes de aplicar.

scholarships.name: Gail Rola Memorial Service Learning Scholarship
scholarships.sponsor: University of North Texas, College of Public Affairs and Health Sciences
scholarships.eligibility: Undergraduate students enrolled full-time in PAHS with 2.5 GPA or above who demonstrate financial need and participate in community service.
scholarships.summary_en: Full-time UNT students in the College of Public Affairs and Health Sciences with a 2.5 GPA or higher can apply. You must show financial need, do community service, and write two short essays.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de licenciatura de tiempo completo en la Facultad de Asuntos Públicos y Ciencias de la Salud de UNT, con promedio de 2.5 o más, pueden aplicar. Deben demostrar necesidad económica, hacer servicio comunitario y escribir dos ensayos cortos.
scholarships.ai_school: University of North Texas, College of Public Affairs and Health Sciences

scholarships.name: PAHS Advisory Board Scholarship
scholarships.sponsor: University of North Texas, College of Public Affairs and Health Sciences
scholarships.eligibility: Undergraduate students enrolled full-time in PAHS with 3.0 GPA or above.
scholarships.summary_en: Full-time undergraduate students in UNT's College of Public Affairs and Health Sciences with a 3.0 GPA or higher can apply. Write two short essays. Applications are accepted year-round.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes universitarios de tiempo completo en la Facultad de Asuntos Públicos y Ciencias de la Salud de UNT con un promedio de 3.0 o más pueden solicitar. Deben escribir dos ensayos cortos. Se aceptan solicitudes todo el año.

scholarships.name: PAHS Scholarship
scholarships.sponsor: University of North Texas, College of Public Affairs and Health Sciences
scholarships.eligibility: Full-time students in PAHS who meet university academic standards and demonstrate financial need via FAFSA.
scholarships.summary_en: Full-time students in UNT's College of Public Affairs and Health Sciences can apply. Meet school academic standards and show financial need on the FAFSA. Apply any time of year.
scholarships.summary_es: Los estudiantes de tiempo completo en el Colegio de Asuntos Públicos y Ciencias de la Salud de la UNT pueden solicitar. Deben cumplir con los requisitos académicos de la escuela y demostrar necesidad económica con la FAFSA. Pueden solicitar en cualquier época del año.
scholarships.ai_reason: The page confirms up to $1,000, FAFSA-based need, and year-round applications, so a null deadline is correct, though the page does not state the undergraduate level.

scholarships.name: Joyce Ann Brown/Popo Gonzalez Scholarship
scholarships.sponsor: University of North Texas, College of Public Affairs and Health Sciences
scholarships.eligibility: Undergraduate students enrolled full-time in PAHS with 2.5 GPA or above.
scholarships.summary_en: Full-time undergraduate students in UNT's College of Public Affairs and Health Sciences with at least a 2.5 GPA can apply. Write two short essays. Applications are accepted year-round.
scholarships.summary_es: Estudiantes de licenciatura que estudian a tiempo completo en el Colegio de Asuntos Públicos y Ciencias de la Salud de UNT, con promedio de 2.5 o más, pueden solicitarla. Deben escribir dos ensayos cortos. Se aceptan solicitudes todo el año.
